dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Denim arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. His previous owner describes him as social and active. In his previous home Denim was noted to jump up often and nip. This would escalate to breaking skin due to the resident child hitting him in an attempt to stop Denim from jumping. While in care, Denim has been observed to have poor bite inhibition and poor impulse control. Noted to jump up on handlers frequently and mouth their hands and bite their clothing. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Denim Blue
